constraints: Platforms without POSIX file locking must fail explicitly rather than run unprotected
description: Mutating commands take a per-worktree exclusive lock and fail fast; readers never lock
rationale: Docs already said writers within one worktree must serialize, but nothing enforced it. Telos reviews found read-modify-write races (stream tip last-writer-wins) silently lose updates; draft files and the manifest here have the same shape.
requirements: Mutating intentctl commands hold an exclusive per-worktree lock and fail fast with an actionable error when another writer is active
Read-only commands never take the lock
Concurrent writers never silently lose a draft or manifest update
title: Serialized metadata writers
